cargo_config:
[build]
jobs = 16

[target.x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu]
linker = "clang"
rustflags = ["-C", "target-cpu=native", "-C", "link-arg=-fuse-ld=mold", "-C", "split-debuginfo=unpacked"]

[profile.dev]
split-debuginfo = "unpacked"
# 2026-10-01: full debuginfo filled /home (RustyNES's target/ reached 81 GB:
# 37 GB incremental + 20 GB deps + 145k .dwo files). line-tables-only keeps
# file:line in panics/backtraces but drops variable info for debuggers. This
# OVERRIDES projects whose Cargo.toml says `debug = true` (config beats the
# manifest). For one full-debug build: CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=true cargo build
debug = "line-tables-only"

[profile.dev.package."*"]
opt-level = 2

[registries.crates-io]
protocol = "sparse"
